tokens.name: g
tokens.usage: The ground: the page background behind everything (body). Text on it: t1, t2 (t2 on g is 4.98:1 in parchment, above 8:1 elsewhere).

tokens.name: in
tokens.usage: Inset: the stage behind media, a pipeline's chain, the upload progress track. Sits below the ground in tone.

tokens.name: p0
tokens.usage: Floating side panel (aside, the Inspector). Also the text colour of a pressed Gallery filter chip, on t1 (15:1 and up in every theme).

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Surface 1: the rail and panel fill, a take's thumbnail ground, the sound tile, the Toggle's off track, the segmented control's track.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Surface 2: popovers and menus (pop, cm), the composer, an inspector tile (set), an error note's ground.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Surface 3: a chip's fill, an action button (act), the toast, hover on a menu row (mi).

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Surface 4: a text field (in), a tag, the composer's chips, a focused right-click row, a checked menu row.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Surface 5: a pressed segmented button, an expanded chip, the right-click menu's border and separators, a mention's highlight. t2 on s5 is under 4.5:1 in ocean (4.17), aubergine (4.39), espresso (4.26), indigo (4.09) and parchment (3.84): keep small t2 text off s5.

tokens.name: ln
tokens.usage: Line: a choice's (opt) border, the Toggle's off ring. Below 3:1 on s1 in every theme (1.69 to 2.40), as in the source: never the only sign of a control's state.

tokens.name: dash
tokens.usage: Dashed outline of an empty or uploading take card. 3.2:1 to 3.8:1 on s1 in the dark themes; 2.63:1 in parchment (flagged, kept as the source has it).

tokens.name: t2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, headings, mono sub-lines, menu shortcuts, icons at rest. 4.5:1 or more on g, s1, s2 and s3 in every theme, and on s4 except in parchment (4.31, flagged, kept as the source has it); not on s5.

tokens.name: t1
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on g, in, s1 to s5 (8:1 and up in every theme). Also the fill of a pressed Gallery filter chip (with p0 text).

tokens.name: t1b
tokens.usage: Softer primary text: the orb card's length line and long reading text on s1 (11.8:1 and up).

tokens.name: ib
tokens.usage: Info button fill (the small round "i").

tokens.name: it
tokens.usage: Info button glyph, on ib (6.3:1 and up in every theme).

tokens.name: a1
tokens.usage: Accent 1: image work and the primary key (Generate), the focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset), a pressed choice's border, the selected take's outline, the Toggle's on track, a star, a menu tick. Focus ring on g: 3.74:1 in parchment, 8:1 and up elsewhere. As text on g, s1 and s2 it is under 4.5:1 in parchment (3.74 / 4.08 / 4.35): the waiting status (a1 text) misses there, flagged and kept as the source has it; otherwise use it in parchment only for 3:1 marks.

tokens.name: on1
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an a1 fill: the Generate key label, the logo mark, the ok status. 7.8:1 and up in the dark themes; 4.35:1 in parchment (white on #c8553d, flagged, kept as the source has it).

tokens.name: a2
tokens.usage: Accent 2: video and audio work (the key for a video or audio workflow), the selected sound tile's border, the run status, the upload bar, the trim and wave fill on boards. As small text on s5 (the bad status) it is under 4.5:1 in forest 4.37, espresso 4.10, oxblood 4.39, indigo 3.94 (flagged).

tokens.name: on2
tokens.usage: Text on an a2 fill: the video key's label, the run status (6.9:1 and up in every theme).

tokens.name: shd
tokens.usage: Shadow colour: black in the dark themes, warm tan in parchment. Every shadow token is built from it.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors and danger: an error note, a danger menu row (Delete), a warned chip, an unknown mention's wavy underline. On s2, s3, s4: 4.78:1 and up in every theme. Only forest and parchment set it; the other dark themes use forest's.
